blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Understanding the progress of an activity requires tracking how the objects involved change over time. Object state readout provides this information by describing a target object's states and transitions across video frames. Although multimodal large language models (MLLMs) generate detailed visual descriptions, these descriptions may leave the attributes needed to distinguish successive states insufficiently specified. In this paper, we propose look-ahead state readout (LASER), an anticipation-guided agent for object state readout that uses possible next-step changes to determine which attributes to inspect in the present. Given temporally ordered frames and a target object, LASER converts anticipated changes into targeted visual questions and inspects the current frame to establish attribute values. It then checks state readouts and forecasts against independent observations of subsequent frames, refining a state record used to generate the final description. Reusable textual observation skills guide this process and are refined by tracing discrepancies with reference captions to the responsible instructions. Candidate revisions are selected on separate videos based on improved caption quality without increased contradictions with reference facts. Model parameters remain frozen throughout adaptation and inference, and the revised skills remain fixed during evaluation. Experiment results and further analysis on OSCaR and PLM RCap show consistent improvements of LASER over strong baselines and existing approaches, which demonstrates the effectiveness of our approach.
blocks.zh: 要了解某项活动的进展情况,就需要跟踪所涉物体如何随时间变化。 对象状态读取通过描述目标对象的状态和跨视频帧的过渡来提供这种信息. 虽然多式大语言模型(MLLMs)生成了详细的可视化描述,但这些描述可能会留下区分相继状态所需的属性没有得到充分的指定. 在本文中,我们提出取景-前置状态读取(LASER),这是用于对象状态读取的预想-导出剂,它利用可能的下一步修改来确定当前检查的属性. 由于时间顺序框架和目标对象,LASER将预期的变化转换成目标视觉问题并检查当前框架以确定属性值. 然后它对照后续帧的独立观察来检查状态读取和预测,精炼出用于生成最终描述的状态记录. 可重复使用的文字观察技能指导这一进程,并通过追踪与负责指示的参考标题不一致之处来加以改进。 候选人的修改是在经过改进的字幕质量基础上,根据单独的视频进行挑选,而不会与参考事实产生更大的矛盾。 在整个适应和推论过程中,模型参数仍然被冻结,在评价期间订正后的技能保持不变。 对OCSAR和PLM RCap的实验结果和进一步分析显示,LASER在强基线和现有方法方面不断改进,这显示了我们的方法的有效性。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Object state readout describes how a specified object’s condition changes across visual observations, providing a language account of its evolving state ( Nguyen et al., 2024 ; Cho et al., 2025 ) .
Whereas image captioning describes the content of a single image, state readout tracks object attributes across time to distinguish successive states and their transitions.
This makes state readout an important task for procedural planning and robotic interaction, where understanding how actions change objects supports subsequent decisions ( Nguyen et al., 2024 ) .
The central challenge is deciding which attributes reveal a meaningful change, rather than merely recognizing the object or naming its activity.
blocks.zh:
Object state readout描述特定对象的状况如何在视觉观察中变化,提供了其演变状态的语言描述(Nguyen等人,2024年;Cho等人,2025年).
而图像标题则描述单个图像的内容,状态读出音轨对象属性会跨时间区分连续状态及其过渡.
这使得状态读取成为程序规划和机器人交互的重要任务,其中理解动作如何改变对象支持后续决定(Nguyen等人,2024年).
中心挑战是决定哪些属性显示出有意义的变化,而不是仅仅承认对象或命名其活动。

blocks.en:
Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) provide a foundation for describing visual observations in natural language.
Recent studies improve their video descriptions through detailed spatial and temporal grounding ( Xue et al., 2025 ; Cho et al., 2025 ; Kazakos et al., 2025 ; Athar et al., 2025 ) , while temporal benchmarks evaluate their understanding of motion and event order ( Liu et al., 2024 ; Cai et al., 2024 ) .
Related agent studies explore anticipation-guided observation ( Yang et al., 2026 ) and feedback-driven refinement of reusable instructions ( Zhao et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ) .
These capabilities support object state readout, but accurate grounding and temporal ordering alone do not specify which attributes a state description needs to retain for subsequent comparison.
A description may correctly identify an object and its surrounding activity while leaving the property that changes insufficiently specified, weakening the basis for describing its transition across images.
Selecting these attributes requires considering which properties distinguish the object’s possible subsequent states.
For example, for a drawer, opening, closing, and remaining unchanged make its current extension relevant, even when that detail receives little emphasis in a general scene description.
Anticipated changes thus provide a basis for deciding what to inspect, while visual evidence establishes the current attribute value.
The next image provides further evidence for assessing those changes and identifying attributes that require closer inspection.
This connection between possible changes and observable properties motivates using anticipation for attribute selection, subsequent evidence to refine state descriptions, and feedback on those descriptions to improve reusable observation instructions.

多式联运大型语言模型(MLLMs)为描述自然语言的视觉观测提供了基础.
最近的研究通过详细的空间和时间定位改进了视频描述(Xue等人,2025年;Cho等人,2025年;Kazakos等人,2025年;Athar等人,2025年),而时间基准则评价他们对运动和事件顺序的理解(Liu等人,2024年;Cai等人,2024年)。
相关剂学研究探索预测引导观测(杨等人,2026年),反馈驱动完善可重复使用指令(赵等人,2024年;张等人,2026年).
这些能力支持对象状态读出,但仅靠准确的地基和时间顺序并不能说明需要保留哪个状态描述来进行后续比较.

因此,预期的变化为决定检查什么提供了依据,而视觉证据则确定了目前的属性价值。
下一个图像为评估这些变化和确定需要更仔细检查的属性提供了进一步的证据。
这种可能的改变与可观察到的属性之间的联系,促使人们利用对属性选择的预期,后续的证据来完善状态描述,以及对这些描述的反馈来改进可重复使用的观察指令.

blocks.en:
In this paper, we propose look-ahead state readout (LASER), an anticipation-guided agent that guides an MLLM to inspect an object’s current state by anticipating possible next-step changes.
Given a sequence of video frames and a target object, LASER uses observation skills, expressed as reusable textual instructions, to anticipate alternative changes and identify the attributes that distinguish them.
Predictive attribute selection turns these attributes into visual questions and examines the current image to establish their values.
Sequential visual correction then checks the resulting descriptions and anticipated changes against subsequent images, maintaining an evidence-supported state record for the final description.
To improve the observation skills, feedback-guided skill revision traces discrepancies between generated and reference captions to the instructions responsible for observation and description.
It proposes focused edits and retains those that improve caption quality on separate source videos without increasing contradictions with the references.
This process adapts observation instructions while keeping all model parameters fixed, and the resulting skills remain fixed during evaluation.
We evaluate LASER on English benchmarks across various MLLMs, where our approach outperforms strong baselines and existing studies, demonstrating the effectiveness of our approach.
blocks.zh:
在本文中,我们提出“前瞻状态读取”(LASER),这是一个预测指导剂,指导MLLM通过预测下一步可能的变化来检查物体的现状。
鉴于视频帧和目标对象的序列,LASER使用可重复使用的文字指令表达的观察技能来预测替代的更改,并识别区分它们的属性.
预测属性选择将这些属性转化为视觉问题,并检查当前图像以确定其值.
相继的视觉修正,然后对照后续的图像检查所得出的描述和预期的变化,为最终描述保持一个证据支持的状态记录.
为了提高观测技能,反馈指导技能修订发现负责观测和描述的指令在生成和参考标题之间存在差异。
它建议有重点地编辑和保留那些在不增加与参考内容矛盾的情况下提高不同源视频标题质量的内容。
这一过程在调整观察指示的同时保持所有模型参数的固定,由此产生的技能在评价期间保持不变.
我们通过各种小额供资和微型企业方案,对LASER进行英语基准评价,在这些基准中,我们的方法优于强有力的基线和现有的研究,显示了我们的方法的有效性。

blocks.en: 2 The Approach
blocks.zh: 2. 本办法

blocks.en:
We propose look-ahead state readout (LASER), an anticipation-guided agent that considers possible next-step changes to guide observation of an object’s current state.
Figure 1 presents its overall architecture, comprising four components: observation skills , predictive attribute selection , sequential visual correction , and feedback-guided skill revision .
LASER organizes observation and reasoning operations and maintains the state record and local guidance; a frozen MLLM executes the visual inspection and language reasoning within these operations.
Specifically, given T T temporally ordered video frames V = ( I 1 , … , I T ) V=(I_{1},\ldots,I_{T}) , a target prompt P P identifying the object, and a task instruction 𝒯 \mathcal{T} specifying the description scope, LASER processes the observations in sequence.
For each observation I t I_{t} , with t = 1 , … , T t=1,\ldots,T , LASER retrieves observation skills from the skill library ℳ \mathcal{M} to guide which attributes of the target object to inspect and how to describe them. Predictive attribute selection uses these skills to propose possible next-step changes, converts their distinguishing attributes into visual questions, and checks the current image to establish the attribute values.
When the next observation arrives, sequential visual correction checks earlier descriptions and anticipated changes against the new evidence. It updates a state record L t L_{t} of observed attributes, changes, and supporting evidence, and local guidance G t G_{t} containing unresolved questions for subsequent inspection.
After the final observation, LASER composes the description Y ^ \widehat{Y} from the final state record L = L T L=L_{T} .
During adaptation, feedback-guided skill revision uses discrepancies in these readout sequences and reference captions to propose instruction edits, then selects edits through replay on separate videos.

blocks.en: 2.1 Observation Skills
blocks.zh: 2.1 观察技能

blocks.en:
An observation skill is a structured textual instruction that tells the agent what to inspect about an object and how to describe the visual evidence.
Each skill contains six fields: a trigger specifying when the instruction applies, an attribute scope identifying what to inspect, alternative changes suggesting possible next states, visual signs distinguishing those alternatives, observation operations specifying how to check the current image, and expression constraints governing the resulting description.
We organize these observation instructions into a skill library ℳ \mathcal{M} .
For each observation, the MLLM selects relevant skills to guide inspection (see Section 2.2 for details).
Feedback-guided skill revision updates these instructions using caption feedback (Section 2.4 ).
blocks.zh:
观察技巧是一种结构化的文字指导,它告诉代理人检查对象是什么,如何描述视觉证据.
每种技能包含六个领域:一个触发器,说明指示何时适用;一个属性范围,确定检查什么;其他变化,建议可能的下一个状态;视觉标志,区别这些替代品;观察操作,具体说明如何检查当前图像;以及影响结果描述的表达限制。
我们把这些观察指示组织成一个技能库 M\ mathcal{M}.
对于每项意见,劳动和劳工部选择指导检查的相关技能(详情见第2.2节)。
由反馈指导的技能修订使用标题反馈更新这些指示(第2.4节)。

blocks.en: 2.2 Predictive Attribute Selection
blocks.zh: 2.2 预测属性选择

blocks.en:
Predictive attribute selection uses possible next-step changes to determine which attributes matter for describing the object’s current state.
For each image I t I_{t} , the MLLM first observes the target using the task instruction 𝒯 \mathcal{T} and the target information available up to that observation, denoted by P ≤ t P_{\leq t} .
It produces an observation description O t O_{t} containing visible attributes and their values, supporting image regions, and any uncertainty.
This initial observation receives no predicted changes, so its description is grounded in the image.
For t > 1 t>1 , LASER checks earlier descriptions against the new observation before selecting skills.
The resulting K t K_{t} contains the earlier states and observed changes after evidence-supported corrections, while local guidance G t G_{t} records questions that still require inspection.
Both are empty for the first observation.
The MLLM selects skills whose triggers and attribute scopes match O t O_{t} , 𝒯 \mathcal{T} , K t K_{t} , and G t G_{t} , forming ℳ t \mathcal{M}_{t} .
When no skill matches, the MLLM follows the task instruction and directly inspects observable attributes of the target object.

blocks.en:
Using the selected skills, the MLLM anticipates how the target might change by the next observation.
For t < T t<T , it generates a set of hypotheses H t H_{t} from the current description and the information accumulated so far: H t = Anticipate ⁡ ( O t , K t , G t , ℳ t , 𝒯 ) H_{t}=\operatorname{Anticipate}(O_{t},K_{t},G_{t},\mathcal{M}_{t},\mathcal{T}) (2) Each hypothesis identifies an object attribute, a possible next value or change direction, and a visual sign that would distinguish that outcome.
For a drawer, alternatives might be opening further, closing, or remaining unchanged; they make its current extension an informative attribute to inspect.
These hypotheses concern the next available observation and use only the images observed so far.

The MLLM converts the hypotheses into an inspection plan J t J_{t} : a set of questions about the target’s current attributes.
Each question specifies what visual evidence to examine and how that evidence supports a description.
Questions remain neutral about the expected answer; for example, the drawer hypothesis leads to asking how far the drawer is currently extended.
The plan also includes task-relevant attributes already identified in O t O_{t} and unresolved questions in G t G_{t} .
We denote the hypotheses available to planning by H t use H_{t}^{\mathrm{use}} : these are H t H_{t} for t < T t<T and the preceding hypotheses H T − 1 H_{T-1} for the final observation.
The plan is constructed as: J t = Plan ⁡ ( O t , H t use , ℳ t , G t , 𝒯 ) J_{t}=\operatorname{Plan}(O_{t},H_{t}^{\mathrm{use}},\mathcal{M}_{t},G_{t},\mathcal{T}) (3) The MLLM inspects the current image according to J t J_{t} and produces the state readout S t S_{t} by S t = Read ⁡ ( I t , P ≤ t , J t , O t ) S_{t}=\operatorname{Read}(I_{t},P_{\leq t},J_{t},O_{t}) .
The readout records attribute values and their supporting visual evidence, leaving values unresolved when the image is insufficient.
Subsequent observations check this readout and its associated hypotheses through sequential visual correction.

blocks.en: 2.3 Sequential Visual Correction
blocks.zh: 2.3 顺序视觉矫正

blocks.en:
When the agent processes image I t I_{t} ( t > 1 t>1 ), sequential visual correction checks the preceding state description S t − 1 S_{t-1} and predicted changes H t − 1 H_{t-1} against the new visual evidence.
The MLLM uses the observation descriptions O t − 1 O_{t-1} and O t O_{t} , which are obtained without predicted values.
If these descriptions provide insufficient evidence, the MLLM examines the two images again to answer the unresolved visual questions.
This additional inspection produces W t W_{t} without receiving the preceding claimed value or predicted outcome; otherwise, W t W_{t} is empty.
The comparison produces feedback E t E_{t} : E t = Compare ⁡ ( S t − 1 , H t − 1 , O t − 1 , O t , W t , 𝒯 ) E_{t}=\operatorname{Compare}(S_{t-1},H_{t-1},O_{t-1},O_{t},W_{t},\mathcal{T}) (4) The feedback identifies supported or contradicted hypotheses, observed state changes, errors in earlier descriptions, and questions that the available evidence does not resolve.
If an object previously observed as standing is now seated, the agent records the transition and rejects a prediction of continued standing; it does not change the earlier standing observation.
An earlier description is corrected only when visual evidence contradicts that description.
When the object’s identity across the two images is uncertain, the agent leaves the transition unresolved.

blocks.en: 2.4 Feedback-guided Skill Revision
blocks.zh: 2.4 反馈指导技能修订

blocks.en:
Feedback-guided skill revision improves observation instructions using existing reference captions while keeping model parameters fixed.
We divide the source videos into a revision set 𝒟 rev \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{rev}} for identifying problems and proposing edits, and a selection set 𝒟 sel \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{sel}} for evaluating those edits.
The sets contain different videos to test whether edits generalize beyond the examples that motivate them.
In each round, LASER processes the revision videos with the current library.
The MLLM compares generated captions with references and examines the corresponding observations, hypotheses, inspection questions, and state records to identify discrepancy sources.
The comparison identifies omissions and explicit contradictions; details unmentioned in the reference remain unjudged.

反馈指导技能修订改进了利用现有参考标题的观察指示,同时使模型参数保持不变。
我们将源视频分为用于识别问题和提议编辑的修改集D rev\mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{rev},以及用于评价这些编辑的选定集D sel\mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{sel}。
套集包含不同的视频,以测试编辑是否超出激励它们的例子的概括.
在每轮中,LASER都会与目前的库处理修订视频.
MLLM将生成的字幕与参考文献进行比较,并检查相应的观察,假设,检查问题,以及状态记录,以识别差异源.
比较查明了疏漏和明显的矛盾;参考中未提及的细节仍未判断。

blocks.en:
When a relevant attribute is never inspected, it examines whether the skill’s trigger or alternative changes fail to direct attention to that attribute.
When inspection produces an unsupported value, it examines the visual signs and observation operations.
When a supported fact appears in the state record but is missing from the final caption, it examines the expression constraints.
For a discrepancy linked to an existing skill, the MLLM proposes an edit to one responsible field; if no skill covers the situation, it proposes a new skill.
Each proposal produces a candidate library ℳ ′ \mathcal{M}^{\prime} derived independently from the current library ℳ \mathcal{M} .
The MLLM proposes no edit when the available evidence does not identify a responsible instruction.

blocks.en: 3 Experiment Setting
blocks.zh: 3 实验设置

blocks.en: 3.1 Datasets
blocks.zh: 3.1 数据集

blocks.en:
We evaluate object-conditioned captioning on OSCaR ( Nguyen et al., 2024 ) and PLM RCap ( Cho et al., 2025 ) .
We use OSCaR’s released EPIC state-change slot, containing 7K training clips and 500 test clips.
Each example pairs three ordered frames with a named object and a reference description of its state change.
PLM RCap contains 179K training, 4K development, and 10K test region–interval captions.
Given a target masklet and its video interval, the task describes the target’s actions and interactions.
For each benchmark, we select 500 examples from its training split and use their reference captions to adapt observation skills.
We divide these examples into video-disjoint revision and selection sets, using the former to propose instruction edits and the latter to evaluate them.
blocks.zh:
我们评价OCSAR(Nguyen等人,2024年)和PLM RCap(Cho等人,2025年)上的标注对象。
我们使用OSCaR发布的EPIC状态变化插槽,包含7K训练剪辑和500个测试剪辑.
每个示例对齐了三个有命名对象的订购框架和关于其状态变化的参考描述.
方案支助 RCap 包含 179K 训练, 4K 开发, 以及 10K 测试区域 - 间标 。
鉴于目标面具及其视频间隔,任务描述了目标的行动和互动。
对于每个基准,我们从其培训中选择500个实例,并使用其参考标题来调整观察技能。
我们把这些例子分为视频-不关联的修改和选择集,利用前者提议指令编辑,后者评价它们.

blocks.en: 3.2 Baselines and Comparing Models
blocks.zh: 3.2 基线和比较模式

blocks.en: We compare LASER with the following baselines. Direct Captioning generates a target description from the input frames and task instruction in one pass. Sequential Readout describes object states in temporal order and summarizes their changes without anticipating future states. Generic Reinspection extends sequential readout by checking for omissions or inconsistencies. Attribute Checklist selects current-state attributes for inspection and retains visual correction, without next-step hypotheses. Free Anticipation predicts possible future events without identifying their distinguishing attributes and visual signs. LASER (No Skill Revision) uses unadapted initial observation skills. LASER (GEPA Optimization) uses GEPA ( Agrawal et al., 2026 ) to optimize the same prompt interfaces instead of feedback-guided skill revision. LASER (Full) is our full approach.
blocks.zh: 我们比较LASER与以下基线. Direct Captioning从一个通道的输入框和任务指令中生成目标描述. 序列读取按时间顺序描述对象状态,并总结其变化而不预知未来状态. 通用复读通过检查遗漏或不一致之处来延长顺序读出. 属性检查列表选择用于检查的当前状态属性,并保留视觉校正,没有下一步假设. Free Antipation预测未来可能出现的事件,但没有识别其区别属性和视觉标志. LASER(无技能修订)使用未适应的初始观测技能. LASER(GEPA Optimation)使用GEPA(Agrawal等人,2026年)来优化相同的即时界面,而不是反馈引导技能修订. LASER(FUL)是我们的全面方法。

blocks.en:
We also compare LASER with five existing approaches. InstanceCap ( Fan et al., 2025 ) organizes video instances into structured descriptions of their appearance, actions, motion, and position. Matters ( Peng et al., 2025 ) describes local image patches and hierarchically aggregates their details through semantic filtering. RICO ( Wang et al., 2025a ) reconstructs images from captions and revises the captions by comparing the reconstructions with the original images. ReAgent-V ( Zhou et al., 2025 ) combines task-relevant frame selection and tool-derived evidence with critical feedback and multi-perspective answer revision. ScaleCap ( Xing et al., 2026 ) expands captions through targeted visual questions and filters unsupported sentences through contrastive scoring.
We adapt these approaches to object-conditioned captioning and evaluate them on the benchmarks.
blocks.zh:
我们还将LASER与现有的五个方法进行比较。 Casecap(Fan等人,2025年)组织视频实例,对其外表、动作、动作和位置进行结构化描述。 事项 (Peng等人,2025年)描述了本地的图像补丁,并通过语义过滤来分级汇总其细节. RICO(Wang等人,2025a)从标题中重建图像,并通过将重建与原始图像进行比较来修改标题. 试剂 - V (周 al等人,2025年)将任务相关框架选择和工具衍生证据与批判反馈和多视角答案修订相结合. scaleCap(Xing等人,2026年)通过定向视觉问题扩展字幕,并通过对比评分过滤不支持的句子.
我们调整这些方法,使之适应以目标为条件的标题,并根据基准加以评价。

blocks.en: 3.3 Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 3.3 详细执行情况

blocks.en:
Our backbones MLLMs comprise Qwen3.5-4B, Qwen3.5-9B, and Qwen3.5-35B-A3B ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) , plus Ministral-3-3B ( Liu et al., 2026 ) .
The two dense Qwen models each have 32 language layers, with hidden dimensions of 2,560 and 4,096 for the 4B and 9B variants, respectively.
The 35B-A3B variant uses 40 language layers with a hidden dimension of 2,048; its mixture-of-experts layers select 8 of 256 routed experts per token and include a shared expert, with an intermediate dimension of 512 for each expert.
Ministral-3-3B has 26 language layers with a hidden dimension of 3,072 and a 24-layer vision encoder.
blocks.zh:
我们的骨干MLLM包括Quen3.5-4B,Quen3.5-9B和Quen3.5-35B-A3B(Quen Team,2026),加上Ministry-3-3B. (刘等,2026).
两个稠密的Quen模型各有32个语言层,4B和9B变体的隐藏尺寸分别为2,560和4,096.
35B-A3B变体使用40个语言层,隐藏维度为2,048;其混合专家层每符物选择256位路由专家中的8位,并包括一名共享专家,中间维度为每位专家512位.
Ministry-3-3B共有26个语言层,隐藏维度为3,072,并设有24层视觉编码器.

blocks.en:
We divide the adaptation examples into revision and selection sets at a 4:1 ratio, keeping examples from the same video in one set.
For PLM RCap, we uniformly sample eight frames from each target interval; OSCaR uses its three provided frames.
At each observation, LASER selects up to three relevant skills and generates up to three alternative next-step changes.
Skill adaptation runs for at most five rounds, with up to three candidate libraries evaluated per round.
We normalize caption quality scores to [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] and require an improvement of at least ϵ = 0.005 \epsilon=0.005 without increasing reference contradictions.
Adaptation stops when no candidate satisfies these criteria.
All model parameters remain frozen, and the adapted skill library remains fixed during evaluation.
blocks.zh:
我们以4:1的比例将适应实例分为修订和选择集,将同一视频中的实例保留在一个集中。
用于 PLM RCap,我们从每个目标间隔中统一抽取8帧;OSCAR使用它提供的3帧.
每次观察时,LASER最多选择3种相关技能,并产生最多3种可选的下一步变化.
技能改造最多可进行五轮,每轮最多可评价三个候选图书馆。
我们把标题质量分数正常化为 [0, 1] [0, 1] , 并且要求至少改进 QQ = 0.005\epsilon= 0.005 而不增加引用矛盾 。
当没有候选人符合这些标准时,适应就会停止。
所有模型参数仍然冻结,经过调整的技能库在评价期间保持不变。

blocks.en:
For evaluation, we use different metrics for the two benchmarks.
For OSCaR, we report BLEU ( Papineni et al., 2002 ) , ROUGE-1, ROUGE-2, and ROUGE-L ( Lin, 2004 ) , with ROUGE-L as the primary metric.
For PLM RCap, we use the official language-model-judged reference-caption similarity score ( Cho et al., 2025 ) .
Higher values indicate better caption agreement on both tasks.
Evaluation references are accessible only to the scorer.
blocks.zh:
在评价方面,我们对这两项基准采用不同的衡量标准。
关于OSCAR,我们报告BLEU(Papineni等人,2002年),RoUGE-1,RoUGE-2,RoUGE-L(林,2004年),以RoUGE-L为主要衡量标准。
对于PLM RCap,我们使用官方语言模型评断的参考标题相似分数(Cho等人,2025年)。
更高的数值表明,在这两项任务上,标题一致。
评价参考文献仅供记分员查阅。

blocks.en: 4 Results and Analysis
blocks.zh: 4 结果和分析

blocks.en: 4.1 Overall Results
blocks.zh: 4.1 总体结果

blocks.en:
Table 1 presents the results of our approach and baselines on OSCaR and PLM RCap across four backbone MLLMs.
There are several observations.
First, LASER consistently outperforms direct captioning, sequential readout, and generic reinspection across all metrics.
These gains suggest that accurate state descriptions benefit from selecting informative attributes beyond organizing observations temporally or inspecting them repeatedly.
Second, LASER achieves higher scores than both attribute checklists and free anticipation across the evaluated backbones.
This supports connecting possible changes to specific visual attributes, so that anticipation guides what to inspect in the current image.
Third, feedback-guided skill revision improves every reported metric over LASER with the initial skill library.
This indicates that caption feedback helps refine reusable observation instructions without updating model parameters.
Fourth, LASER improves over direct captioning for all four backbones, spanning different model sizes, model families, and dense and mixture-of-experts architectures, which demonstrates the robustness of our approach.

第二,LASER的得分高于属性核对表和所有被评价骨干的自由预期。
这支持将可能的修改与特定的视觉属性连接起来,这样预测就可以指导在当前图像中检查什么.
第三,通过初始技能库,反馈指导技能修订改进了所报告的每个衡量标准。
这表明标题反馈有助于在不更新模型参数的情况下完善可重复使用的观测指令.
第四,LASER改进了对所有四个骨干的直接标题,跨越了不同的模型大小、模范家庭以及密集和混合的专家结构,这表明了我们方法的稳健性。

blocks.en:
Table 2 compares LASER with five existing approaches adapted to object-conditioned captioning using Qwen3.5-9B as the backbone MLLM.
LASER outperforms all compared approaches on both benchmarks, which demonstrates the effectiveness of using anticipated changes to identify state-distinguishing attributes and refining their descriptions through subsequent visual evidence and caption feedback.
blocks.zh:
表2将LASER与5种现有方法进行了比较,这些方法采用Qune3.5-9B作为主干MLLM,以适应对象条件说明。
LASER在两个基准上都比其他方法要好,这表明了利用预期变化确定区分状态属性并通过随后的视觉证据和字幕反馈来完善其描述的有效性。

blocks.en: Table 2: Comparison of our approach with existing studies on using Qwen3.5-9B as the backbone MLLM. The best and second-best results are marked by boldface and underlines, respectively.
blocks.zh: 表2:我们的方法与关于使用Quen3.5-9B作为MLLM骨干的研究的比较。 最佳和次最佳的成果分别是大胆的和强调的。

blocks.en: 4.2 Ablation Study
blocks.zh: 4.2 阅读研究

blocks.en:
We examine whether anticipated changes help identify current-state evidence and whether independent observation limits reliance on predicted values.
Using Qwen3.5-9B as the backbone MLLM on both benchmarks, we independently remove current reinspection, remove discriminating visual signs, or expose the initial observer to preceding hypotheses, retaining the full approach’s revised skills in each case.
Table 3 compares these variants with full LASER and direct captioning.
Removing current reinspection lowers every metric, supporting the use of anticipated changes to guide a second examination of the present image.
Removing discriminating signs also lowers every metric and produces the largest ROUGE-L decline among the ablations.
This pattern suggests that identifying possible changes is more useful when those changes are connected to explicit visual criteria for inspection.
Exposing the initial observer to predicted changes reduces all reported scores and produces the largest decline in RCap similarity among the ablations.
The result supports keeping initial visual observations independent of forecasts, so that later comparisons rely on separately obtained evidence.
All three ablated variants remain above direct captioning, indicating that each removed operation contributes to the full approach while the remaining observation structure retains value.
blocks.zh:
我们审查预期的变化是否有助于确定目前状况的证据,以及独立观察是否限制了对预测值的依赖。
用Quen3.5-9B作为两个基准的MLLM骨干,我们独立地去掉目前的复检,去掉歧视性的视觉标志,或者让最初的观察者接触到之前的假设,在每种情况下都保留全方法的修改技能.
表3将这些变体与完整的LASER和直接标题进行比较.
删除当前复检会降低每个度量,支持使用预期变化来指导对当前图像的第二次检查.
消除歧视性迹象还降低每一公尺,并在枯萎中产生最大的RoUGE-L下降。
这种模式表明,如果这些变化与检查的明确视觉标准相联系,那么确定可能的变化就更加有用。
让最初的观察者预测变化会降低所有报告得分,并产生最大的RCap相似性下降。
其结果支持将初步的视觉观测与预测独立起来,以便以后的比较依赖于单独获得的证据。
所有三种减速变体都保留在直接标题之上,表明每个去掉的操作都有助于全面方法,而其余的观察结构则保留价值.

blocks.zh: 表3:预测观测的减值研究结果,含Quen3.5-9B.

Each case shows the input frames and target region, an anticipated change, later visual evidence, the model caption, and the reference. Case 1 links an anticipated forward lean to a visual inspection criterion. Case 2 rejects a standing forecast and preserves the observed transition to sitting. Green contours identify the target.
blocks.zh: 图 2: 说明某些态势变化的两个区域概况案例。 每个案例都显示输入框架和目标区域、预期的变化、后来的视觉证据、模型标题和参考。 案例1将预期前进与视觉检查标准挂钩。 案件2拒绝长期预报,保留了观察到的向开庭过渡。 绿色轮廓识别目标。

blocks.en: 4.3 Case Study
blocks.zh: 4.3 个案研究

blocks.en:
We use two region-captioning cases from source videos to illustrate how LASER handles supported and contradicted predictions.
Figure 2 shows the input frames and target regions in panel (a), state estimates and predictions in panel (b), subsequent visual checks in panel (c), and the generated and reference captions in panels (d) and (e).
Green contours identify the target whose state is tracked.
blocks.zh:
我们用两个来自源视频的区域封装案例来说明LASER如何处理支持和反驳预测.
图2显示面板(a)中的输入框和目标区域、面板(b)中的状态估计和预测、面板(c)中的随后的视觉检查以及面板(d)和(e)中的生成和参考标题。
绿色轮廓识别目标 其状态被跟踪。

blocks.en:
In Case 1, the anticipated forward lean directs inspection toward the target’s torso angle relative to the sink.
The later image supports this change, and the final caption describes the lean while preserving the ongoing dishwashing activity.
The reference mentions dishwashing without explicitly describing the lean, so the displayed images provide the evidence for this additional posture detail.
The case illustrates how an anticipated change becomes a specific visual criterion used in the final description.
In Case 2, LASER anticipates continued standing with a slight forward lean, but the later observation shows the target seated on the bicycle.
Sequential visual correction rejects the forecast, retains the earlier standing state, and records the newly observed transition.
The final caption describes the target sitting on the bicycle, consistent with the reference’s account of getting onto it.
The case illustrates that an incorrect forecast still leaves room for evidence-supported state readout: subsequent observations determine the transition without changing a supported earlier state.
blocks.zh:
在案例1中,预期的向前倾斜指向目标躯干角度相对于水槽的检查。
后期的图像支持这种改变,最后的字幕描述精度,同时保留正在进行的洗碗活动.
参考文献提到洗碗时没有明确描述精度,因此显示的图像为这种额外的姿势细节提供了证据.
案例说明了预期的变化如何成为最后描述中使用的具体视觉标准。
在案例2中,LASER预计会继续站立,略微向前倾斜,但后来的观察显示目标坐在自行车上.
连续的视觉修正拒绝预测,保留较早的状态,并记录新观察到的过渡.
最后的字幕描述了坐在自行车上的目标,与参考文献中登机的描述一致。
案件表明,不正确的预测仍然为证据支持状态的读取留有余地:随后的观察在不改变先前支持状态的情况下决定了过渡.

blocks.en: 5 Related Work
blocks.zh: 5 相关工作

blocks.en:
Object-centered video understanding studies state localization ( Xue et al., 2024 ; Souček et al., 2022 ) , transformation graphs ( Sun et al., 2025 ) , and segmentation through appearance changes ( Yu et al., 2023 ) .
Region-captioning approaches emphasize object representations ( Yuan et al., 2025 ) and local–global context ( Lian et al., 2025 ) , while OSCaR ( Nguyen et al., 2024 ) and PerceptionLM ( Cho et al., 2025 ) provide state-change and region-captioning tasks, respectively.
Agent approaches organize reasoning and interaction ( Yao et al., 2023 ) , execute visual programs ( Gupta and Kembhavi, 2023 ) , and gather evidence through iterative inspection ( Wang et al., 2024 ) , keyframe selection ( Wang et al., 2025b ) , or evidence-sufficiency assessment ( Wang et al., 2026 ) .
StreamAgent anticipates where and when task-relevant information will appear to guide evidence acquisition and response timing in streaming video question answering ( Yang et al., 2026 ) .
Other uses of possible outcomes include counterfactual supervision for video representation learning ( Kung et al., 2025 ) and robot behavior forecasting in TRACE ( Puthumanaillam et al., 2025 ) .
Feedback-based approaches revise responses ( Madaan et al., 2023 ) or retain experience as reflections ( Shinn et al., 2023 ) , workflows ( Wang et al., 2025c ) , manuals ( Chen et al., 2024 ) , and evolving contextual playbooks ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) .
Prompt optimization uses scored candidates ( Yang et al., 2024 ) , textual critiques ( Pryzant et al., 2023 ) , modular instruction search ( Khattab et al., 2024 ; Opsahl-Ong et al., 2024 ) , and feedback propagation ( Yuksekgonul et al., 2025 ) ; GEPA uses execution traces to reflect on and evolve prompts ( Agrawal et al., 2026 ) .
LASER focuses on the role of anticipation in determining what constitutes an informative description of the present: alternative next-step changes identify the object attributes and visual signs to inspect in the current image, whose evidence establishes their values.
Subsequent observations check these values and transitions, while caption discrepancies guide revisions to the responsible attribute-selection, visual-inspection, or expression instructions, making the observation criteria themselves the target of adaptation.
blocks.zh:
以物体为中心的视频理解研究国家本地化(薛等人,2024年;苏切克等人,2022年),变形图(孙等人,2025年),通过外观变化分化(余等人,2023年).
区域封装方法强调物体表示(袁等人,2025年)和地方-全球背景(Lian等人,2025年),而OSCAR(阮等人,2024年)和PerceptionLM(乔等人,2025年)分别提供国家变化和区域封装任务.
代理方法组织推理与互动(姚等人,2023年),执行视觉程序(Gupta和Kembhavi,2023年),通过迭代检查(Wang等人,2024年),关键框架选择(Wang等人,2025b),或证据充足性评估(Wang等人,2026年)收集证据.
StreamAgent预计,与任务有关的信息将出现在何时何地,以指导证据的获取和在流程视频问答中的反应时间(Yang等人,2026年)。
其他可能的结果的用途包括反事实监督视频表现学习(Kung等人,2025年)和TRACE中的机器人行为预测(Puthumanaillam等人,2025年).
基于反馈的办法修订答复(Madaan等人,2023年)或保留经验作为反思(Shinn等人,2023年),工作流程 (Wang et al.,2025c),手册(Chen et al.,2024),以及不断发展的背景剧本(Zhang et al.,2026).
快速优化使用得分候选人(Yang等人,2024年),文字批判(Pryzant等人,2023年),模块化指令搜索(Khattab等人,2024年;Opsahl-Ong等人,2024年),以及反馈传播(Yukekgonul等人,2025年);GEPA使用执行痕迹来反思和演化提示(Agrawal等人,2026年)。
LASER侧重于预期在确定什么构成对当前信息性描述的作用:替代的下一步变化识别对象属性和视觉标志,以检查当前图像,其证据确定了其价值.
随后的观测检查这些值和过渡,而字幕差异则指导对负责任的属性选择,视觉检查,或表达指令的修订,使观测标准本身成为适应的目标.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
In this paper, we propose look-ahead state readout (LASER), an anticipation-guided agent that uses possible next-step changes to determine which object attributes deserve attention in the present.
LASER converts anticipated changes into current-state inspection questions and uses subsequent visual evidence to refine the state record for description.
Feedback-guided skill revision improves reusable observation instructions through caption feedback while keeping all model parameters fixed.
Experiments on OSCaR and PLM RCap demonstrate consistent improvements over direct captioning and alternative observation strategies across four MLLM backbones, and LASER outperforms the five compared existing approaches.
Ablations support the importance of inspecting current attributes, identifying distinguishing visual signs, and checking predictions against independent observations.
blocks.zh:
在本文中,我们提议寻找-ahead状态读取(LASER),这是一种预测-引导剂,它使用可能的下一步变化来确定哪些对象属性值得目前关注.
LASER将预期的变化转换为当前状态检查问题,并使用后续的视觉证据来完善状态记录进行描述.
反馈指导技能修订通过字幕反馈改进了可重复使用的观察指令,同时保持所有模型参数固定.
对OSCAR和PLM RCap的实验表明,在四个MLLM主干线上,直接字幕和替代观测战略的改进是始终如一的,而LASER比现有五个方法要好。
偏差支持检查当前属性,识别区分视觉标志,对照独立观察检查预测的重要性.
